subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Employee Appreciation Day!
body: Dear Team Members, We are excited to announce that our Annual Employee Appreciation Day is coming up on Friday, June 25th. This year, we have planned a fun-filled day with team-building activities, games, and a special lunch to celebrate all your hard work and dedication. Please mark your calendars and stay tuned for more details on the schedule and activities. We can't wait to show our appreciation for all that you do! Best regards, The HR Team
